# 1754. Largest Merge Of Two Strings

## Solution 1 (time O((m+n)*max(m,n)), space O(m+n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def largestMerge(self, word1, word2):
        """
        :type word1: str
        :type word2: str
        :rtype: str
        """
        ans = ""
        p1, p2 = 0, 0
        n, m = len(word1), len(word2)
        while p1 < n or p2 < m:
            if p1 < n and word1[p1:] > word2[p2:]:
                ans += word1[p1]
                p1 += 1
            else:
                ans += word2[p2]
                p2 += 1
        return ans
```
